events.summary: Speaker B set the brief: a new remote control that is original, trendy and user friendly.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: it's supposed to be original, trendy and user friendly.

events.summary: Speaker B said the design has three stages, each with individual work followed by a meeting.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: there are three different stages to the design.

events.summary: Speaker B said the remote control will be sold for 25 EUR.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we're gonna be selling this remote control for twenty five Euro

events.summary: Speaker B said the aim is to make 50 million EUR in sales.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we're aiming to make fifty million Euro

events.summary: Speaker B set the production cost cap at 12.50 EUR, so the product must not cost more than that.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: we don't want it to cost any more than uh twelve fifty Euros

events.summary: Speaker B said the production cost cap is 50 percent of the selling price.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: so fifty percent of the selling price

events.summary: Speaker B concluded the 25 EUR price is the company's own sale price, since retailers set their own shelf prices.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: because it's probably up to the the um the retailer to uh sell it
